clusters.mechanism: A classifyCi exception for one PR escapes record() and aborts the repository's observation loop, and persisted ciPending repeats the failure every poll, so later PRs are starved.
The main-red branch continues before job inspection and recordCiFailure, so those failures never enter the ledger.
The check_run_url and rerun prefix comparisons are case-sensitive, so canonical repository casing from GitHub is rejected.
Rerun reconciliation reads only the latest workflow attempt, so a later partial rerun hides the tracked job's result and leaves it ambiguous.
Rerun completion is inspected only when ciKey changes, but the GraphQL query sees only the first 100 contexts, so the outcome of a rerun outside that page is never observed.
The transient timeout regexes are too narrow or anchored too strictly, so genuine test timeout diagnostics are classified as needs_fix instead of rerun.
Security-test detection misses common failure formats such as Playwright headings and Go FAIL lines, so security failures are rerun and recorded.
A main-red pause leaves ciPending true, so the full REST inspection repeats on every poll even though the GraphQL state is unchanged.
record() returns early when observePrHead refuses, dropping the whole observation, including merge, close and review events.
A rerun request that GitHub never accepts (429 or network failure) stays rerun_requested forever, with no retry and no needs_fix.
After a successful rerun, lagging check-runs data still lists the original failed job, so a confirmed pass is reported as ci.needs_fix.
ci.main_red items are keyed per check name instead of once per repository.
Legacy commit statuses on main are fetched only when the PR snapshot has StatusContext entries or is truncated, so a failing main status can be missed.
Classification is limited to OPEN PRs, so a pr.ci_failed emitted when a PR closes with pending CI is never classified.
A rerun that ends in a conclusion that is neither success nor a bad one (neutral, skipped) stays rerunning forever and keeps the PR pending.
The feed excerpt is the first 2000 characters of the job log (runner setup output), not the failure.
ciSignature picks the first loosely matching log line, including incidental setup lines and run timings, so signatures are wrong and vary between occurrences.
Untrusted GitHub text is quoted with an ad-hoc '> ' prefix instead of the codebase's quotedJson convention.
The change is about twice the stated source-line budget and concentrated in a dense 340-411 line classifyCi closure.
A second migration alters a table created by an earlier migration in the same unshipped change.
The security regex has no word boundaries, so unrelated words such as 'disaster' count as security evidence.
Every cancelled job is treated as transient, including fail-fast matrix siblings, so they are rerun and recorded as flakes.
Each transient job is rerun with its own POST, and later POSTs may be rejected as 4xx and reported as needs_fix.
